name: assess-project-quality
permissions: read repository files and available CI evidence
risks: mistake implicit patterns or local missing guards for reachable defects
preserve legacy defects or accept migration based on a weak comparator
mitigations: separate implementation, execution, enforcement and proof scope
keep private evidence within authorized output destinations
limit initial pilots, use compact reports and require measured rollout criteria
recover contract and caller context, attempt refutation and distinguish candidates from confirmed findings
classify intended differences, test comparator controls and trace release activation
